title: Loko
text: 2 Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā || la || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Loko loko ti bhante vuccati || || Kittāvatā nu kho bhante loko ti vuccatīti || || Lujjatīti kho bhikkhu tasmā loko ti vuccati || || Kiñca lujjati || || 4-9 Cakkhu kho bhikkhu lujjati || || Rūpā lujjanti || || Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ lujjati || || Cakkhusamphasso lujjati || pe || || Yam pidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ vā || tam pi lujjati || || 10 Lujjatīti kho bhikkhu tasmā lokoti vuccatīti || ||
